# sidecar: `SidecarReport`

The `data` payload of `openreadout info FILE --view full --sidecar --json`, inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `info --view full --sidecar` for one input.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/sidecar.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/sidecar.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema sidecar`.
